# EdZola

> EdZola (EdZola Technologies Private Limited, Coimbatore, India) designs, builds and runs the systems behind nonprofit programmes: programme MIS, case management, donor CRM, voice AI evaluation, DPDP readiness and AI agents. AI handles the volume; people keep the decisions that carry consequence. 100+ organisations, 150+ systems, 16 sectors and 5+ countries since 2020. Zoho Advanced Partner and Claude partner. Contact: reachus@edzola.com

Key facts:
- Founded in 2020 in Coimbatore, India. Around 75% of the work is with nonprofits and the wider impact sector.
- Every project is delivered on ImpactOS, EdZola's method: fixed stages and sign-off gates, reusable sector knowledge, and AI tools that always have a named person reviewing their output.
- Platform follows the problem: often Zoho (Creator, CRM, People), sometimes custom code. Partners own their data on any platform.
- Beneficiary and donor data is never used to train models or shared openly.

## What EdZola does

- [Data systems](https://edzola.ai/#model): Programme MIS, case management, donor CRM and HR, built around one ID per person, household or case, from first visit to funder report.
- [Zolabs](https://edzola.ai/zolabs/): Voice AI evaluation. AI-led phone interviews in local languages for evaluations, beneficiary feedback and follow-ups, with every finding traceable to what was said.
- [ZolaShield](https://edzola.ai/zolashield/): DPDP Act readiness for Indian nonprofits. A 15-minute voice assessment produces a data map, a scored risk report and a 180-day action plan. Assess from ₹10,000; Comply and Sustain tiers for implementation.
- [DozAI](https://edzola.ai/dozai/): AI teammates and end-to-end missions (for example scholarship screening) that handle operational volume, with people deciding exceptions. Pilots open.
- [ImpactOS](https://edzola.ai/impact-os/): The delivery method behind all of the above: method, knowledge and tools, so no project starts from zero.

## About EdZola

- [About and team](https://edzola.ai/about/): Origin story (Zoho, Teach For India, founded 2020), values, the team, and careers. Open roles: https://go.edzola.com/hiring
- [News and media](https://edzola.ai/news/): Impact Dialogues by EdZola (fireside conversations with nonprofit leaders), partner stories, the quarterly EdZola Chronicle newsletter and press coverage.

## Get involved

- [Founding Digital Patrons](https://edzola.ai/patrons/): The Built for Impact Fund's first campaign. 100 patrons at $1,000 each fund 100 nonprofits with a CRM or MIS that is built, adopted and supported for a year.

## Thinking and field guides

- [How EdZola thinks](https://edzola.ai/thinking/): Founding thesis, field guides and selected essays.
- [Founding thesis](https://edzola.ai/why/): Six commitments: systems are still the foundation; every project must compound; AI handles volume, people handle consequence; judgement should become accessible; the people closest to communities deserve serious infrastructure; build openly where possible.
- [Building technology that sticks](https://edzola.ai/field-guides/technology-that-sticks/): Seven field essays on readiness, trust, delivery, leadership and shared infrastructure from six years of nonprofit implementations.
- [How nonprofits actually work](https://edzola.ai/thinking/how-nonprofits-operate/): A six-chapter guide to the people, money, evidence and systems inside any nonprofit.

## Sector pages

- [All 16 sectors](https://edzola.ai/sectors/): Programme data systems by sector, each built around one connected record.
- [Education](https://edzola.ai/education/): Know which child can read, and which one quietly stopped coming.
- [Youth Development & Employability](https://edzola.ai/youth-employability/): Placement letters are easy. Month-six retention is the real test.
- [Livelihoods & Economic Empowerment](https://edzola.ai/livelihoods/): From wealth ranking to graduation, know which households actually moved.
- [Health & Wellbeing](https://edzola.ai/health/): From the household visit to cured: every patient counted, none lost.
- [Mental Health](https://edzola.ai/mental-health/): Care that's measured gently, kept private, and never loses someone.
- [Maternal & Child Health](https://edzola.ai/maternal-child-health/): One mother, one baby, tracked from first trimester to first birthday.
- [Child Rights & Protection](https://edzola.ai/child-protection/): Every decision on a child's file, made in their best interest
- [Gender Equality & Women's Empowerment](https://edzola.ai/gender/): Counting what women decide, not only what women receive
- [Disability & Inclusion](https://edzola.ai/disability/): Count functioning, remove barriers, track inclusion. Nothing about us without us.
- [Human Rights & Access to Justice](https://edzola.ai/justice/): From grievance to enforced remedy, with every deadline tracked
- [Environment & Climate](https://edzola.ai/environment/): Restoration counted in surviving trees and working institutions, not saplings planted
- [Waste Management](https://edzola.ai/waste/): Every kilo recovered traced to a ward, a worker and a wage
- [Food Systems](https://edzola.ai/food-systems/): From seed on credit to a hot meal, tracked per plate
- [Community Development](https://edzola.ai/community-development/): Villages own the plan. The data should prove who was heard.
- [Media & Journalism](https://edzola.ai/media/): From the tip to the correction to the policy that changed
- [Arts & Culture](https://edzola.ai/arts/): Follow the artist from open call to archive to career
